note: The sprite-size probe (issue #11): the same man-at-arms at two sizes, each with a walk and a sword attack. Pro for the stills, since the look is what is being judged. Each size gets the template "attack" (1 generation) and a custom pro slash (10 to 25), to compare. Estimates from the API's published formulas; the first run measures them. The Pro character creator caps at 168 pixels (HTTP 422 on 256, 2026-10-11), so the large size is 168.
